cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a People Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential Functions
Gather and compile people-related data from various sources, such as HCM, payroll systems, candidate and employee surveys, and other relevant databases.
Analyze people data to identify trends, patterns, and correlations, providing insights into talent acquisition, workforce demographics, performance, retention and turnover, compensation, benefits, and more.
Ensure that HR data is accurately represented and effectively communicated through visual aids and reports.
Help drive internal insights and feedback strategy from data understanding to plans of action.
Collaborate with the People Team to align workforce planning with organizational goals and objectives.
Identify areas for process optimization within HR operations based on data analysis findings.
Additional Responsibilities
Provide insights to support decision-making related to compensation adjustments and benefit offerings.
Design performance strategies and processes that measure desired outcomes.
Recommend strategies for enhancing diversity and inclusion initiatives.
Assist in creating and maintaining accurate HR records for audit and compliance purposes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and insights for various HR initiatives.
Support of and involvement in company, department, and/or safety policies, procedures, programs and activities.
Maintenance of a clean and orderly work area.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and trends.
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Office, etc.).
Knowledge of HR metrics, practices, and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey findings effectively.
Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy in data analysis.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive HR data appropriately.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
SHRM, HRCI or other HR related certification.
Experience with statistical analysis and predictive modeling techniques.
Familiarity with HCM systems and databases. Proficiency in Workday is a plus!
Physical Requirements
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
Employee must exert up to 30 lbs. Of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 lbs. Of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include near acuity, far acuity, depth perception, accommodation, color vision, and field of vision.
This description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications. The position, duties, and qualifications are subject to change at any time.

People who do well in this role are often quick to make sense of HR data and the patterns within it.
cond_0175.responsibilities:
Gather and compile people-related data from various sources, such as HCM, payroll systems, candidate and employee surveys, and other relevant databases.
Analyze people data to identify trends, patterns, and correlations, providing insights into talent acquisition, workforce demographics, performance, retention and turnover, compensation, benefits, and more.
Ensure that HR data is accurately represented and effectively communicated through visual aids and reports.
Help drive internal insights and feedback strategy from data understanding to plans of action.
Collaborate with the People Team to align workforce planning with organizational goals and objectives.
Identify areas for process optimization within HR operations based on data analysis findings.
Provide insights to support decision-making related to compensation adjustments and benefit offerings.
Design performance strategies and processes that measure desired outcomes.
Recommend strategies for enhancing diversity and inclusion initiatives.
Assist in creating and maintaining accurate HR records for audit and compliance purposes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and insights for various HR initiatives.
Support of and involvement in company, department, and/or safety policies, procedures, programs and activities.
Maintenance of a clean and orderly work area.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0175.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
SHRM, HRCI or other HR related certification preferred.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and trends.
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Office, etc.).
Experience with statistical analysis and predictive modeling techniques.
Knowledge of HR metrics, practices, and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey findings effectively.
Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy in data analysis.
Familiarity with HCM systems and databases. Proficiency in Workday is a plus!
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive HR data appropriately.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
Employee must exert up to 30 lbs. Of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 lbs. Of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include near acuity, far acuity, depth perception, accommodation, color vision, and field of vision.
This description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications. The position, duties, and qualifications are subject to change at any time.

cond_0393.responsibilities:
Gather and compile people-related data from various sources, such as HCM, payroll systems, candidate and employee surveys, and other relevant databases.
Analyze people data to identify trends, patterns, and correlations, and regularly communicate insights into talent acquisition, workforce demographics, performance, retention and turnover, compensation, benefits, and more.
Ensure that HR data is accurately represented and effectively communicated through visual aids and reports — walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions as they come up.
Actively contribute to internal insights and feedback strategy, from data understanding to plans of action.
Work closely and regularly with the People Team to align workforce planning with organizational goals and objectives.
Identify areas for process optimization within HR operations based on data analysis findings, and bring those observations forward proactively.
Provide insights to support decision-making related to compensation adjustments and benefit offerings.
Design performance strategies and processes that measure desired outcomes.
Recommend strategies for enhancing diversity and inclusion initiatives.
Assist in creating and maintaining accurate HR records for audit and compliance purposes.
Connect regularly with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and insights for various HR initiatives.
Support of and involvement in company, department, and/or safety policies, procedures, programs and activities.
Maintenance of a clean and orderly work area.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0393.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
SHRM, HRCI or other HR related certification preferred.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and trends.
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Office, etc.).
Experience with statistical analysis and predictive modeling techniques.
Knowledge of HR metrics, practices, and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey findings effectively.
Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy in data analysis.
Familiarity with HCM systems and databases. Proficiency in Workday is a plus.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive HR data appropriately.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
Employee must exert up to 30 lbs. Of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 lbs. Of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include near acuity, far acuity, depth perception, accommodation, color vision, and field of vision.
